summary: Polytron's employees, HR team and service centers rely on internal apps for their daily work. On the application team I build and maintain four of them, from the interface and API down to the SQL database, run them in Docker containers so they're easy to deploy, and add AI features to two of them.
impact: The employee self-service app (ESS) I built is now the gateway to 6+ internal apps, used by every Polytron employee.
The queue management system (QMS) I adapted runs at every Polytron service center.
My research on the supply-chain AI assistant (SCM) became the benchmark for adopting AI at Polytron.
